shared.closing: Use these ideas as a starting point. Review every clip with its context and audience in mind.

regla-3-segundos.title: How to open a clip and hold attention
regla-3-segundos.description: The opening seconds help explain what a clip is about. A clear start lets viewers decide whether to keep watching.

tips.first: Start with the action or main idea, without a long introduction.
tips.second: Use a first frame that makes sense even without sound.
tips.third: Review pacing and context before publishing.

convertir-4h-stream-clips.title: From a long stream to clips you can review
convertir-4h-stream-clips.description: A live stream contains many conversations and reactions. Selecting specific moments makes them easier to share later.

tips.first: Split the video by topic or scene changes.
tips.second: Review every suggested segment before cutting it.
tips.third: Adjust the start and end so the clip makes sense on its own.

83-streamers-abandona.title: Why save the best moments from a stream
83-streamers-abandona.description: A live broadcast ends, but a great play or conversation can keep circulating as a short clip.

tips.first: Mark the reactions your community remembers.
tips.second: Give each moment enough context to understand it.
tips.third: Write a description that points back to the full stream.

7-momentos-virales.title: Which moments are worth turning into clips
7-momentos-virales.description: Not every segment needs the same treatment. A complete idea often works better than a cut chosen only for intensity.

tips.first: Look for clear explanations, reactions or topic changes.
tips.second: Check that the clip has a beginning and an end.
tips.third: Avoid promising virality: focus on what the clip gives your audience.

de-2-a-10-clientes.title: How to organize clips for several clients
de-2-a-10-clientes.description: When you work with different brands, a clear workflow prevents confusion between files, styles and approvals.

tips.first: Separate material by project or client.
tips.second: Name videos and clips so they are easy to find.
tips.third: Review branding and copy before each delivery.

clip-economy-latam.title: Short video for audiences in Latin America
clip-economy-latam.description: Creators and teams in the region can repurpose conversations, lessons and streams to reach new audiences.

tips.first: Keep the expressions that give the creator their voice.
tips.second: Add readable captions when the audio matters.
tips.third: Adapt each clip's context to the channel where it will appear.

kick-vs-twitch.title: Preparing clips from different streaming platforms
kick-vs-twitch.description: The platform used for a stream affects how you obtain its recording, but editorial review remains essential.

tips.first: Confirm that you have permission to use the recording.
tips.second: Import a supported link or upload the file.
tips.third: Check framing, duration and audio before publishing.

titulos-10x-clicks.title: Writing clear titles for your clips
titulos-10x-clicks.description: A useful title describes the idea in the video without exaggerating what happens in it.

tips.first: Name the topic or question answered by the clip.
tips.second: Avoid numbers or promises the video cannot support.
tips.third: Check how the title appears on each channel.

flujo-perfecto-clipero.title: A practical workflow for reviewing and delivering clips
flujo-perfecto-clipero.description: A repeatable process helps move from recording to delivery while protecting quality.

tips.first: Keep the source video in its project.
tips.second: Review AI suggestions and correct the cuts.
tips.third: Check captions, framing and the final file.

streamers-clips-crecen-5x.title: Clips that introduce a stream to new viewers
streamers-clips-crecen-5x.description: A clip can show a broadcast to someone who never saw the full stream.

tips.first: Choose moments that make sense without knowing the channel.
tips.second: Point to the original stream when context helps.
tips.third: Watch your community's response to learn what to share next.

subtitulos-animados-retienen.title: Readable captions for short video
subtitulos-animados-retienen.description: Captions help people follow an idea when audio is unavailable. Clarity matters more than filling the screen with effects.

tips.first: Correct names, figures and misheard words.
tips.second: Keep good contrast and size in vertical format.
tips.third: Make sure text does not cover faces or platform controls.

latam-lidera-crecimiento.title: Creating clips for Latin American audiences
latam-lidera-crecimiento.description: A literal translation may lose the context of a conversation. Reviewing references and local expressions helps communication.

tips.first: Keep the meaning of local expressions.
tips.second: Add brief context when a reference may be unfamiliar.
tips.third: Review the result with someone who knows the audience.

como-convertir-entrevistas-en-clips-el-m.title: Turn an interview into useful clips
como-convertir-entrevistas-en-clips-el-m.description: An interview often contains several independent ideas. Separating them helps share complete answers.

tips.second: Keep the start of the answer when context requires it.
tips.third: Review names and the speaker's framing.

como-reducir-tiempo-edicion-clips-equipo.title: Reduce repeated work in a clip team
como-reducir-tiempo-edicion-clips-equipo.description: A team works more clearly when clip selection, editing and approval are separate steps.

tips.first: Define who reviews each project stage.
tips.second: Use shared rules for file and version names.

como-reutilizar-webinars-linkedin-tiktok.title: Repurpose a webinar across channels
como-reutilizar-webinars-linkedin-tiktok.description: A long talk can yield clips with different angles for different audiences and channels.

tips.first: Choose an explanation that stands on its own.
tips.second: Adapt the publishing text to each platform.
tips.third: Review duration, captions and aspect ratio before sharing.

herramienta-clips-automaticos-para-agenc.title: Choose a clip workflow for your agency
herramienta-clips-automaticos-para-agenc.description: Before adopting a tool, check how it fits your clients' projects and review process.

tips.first: Check which features your chosen plan includes.
tips.second: Try the workflow with a real team video.
tips.third: Review file delivery and visual consistency.
